content.short: DIBS is a fast-paced logic game with NFTs in which you have fun while attempting to win DIBS TOKENS from your pals.
content.description:
The DIBS GAME™️ is a very popular multiplayer game that emphasizes social interaction across a variety of digital platforms. Land Parcels are owned by DIBS in numerous Multiverses and will be used in Virtual Reality game sets.

The DIBS GAME™️ makes use of a Cardano Native Token (DIBS TOKEN) and CNFTs with the 'Lucky Hand' utility tool for skin character modification.
